fullContent:
Katakakhadiradi Kashayam 
 Reference – Sahasrayogam, Kashaya Prakarna, Pramehahara Kashaya. 
 Introduction 
 Katakakhadiradi Kashayam is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to contain mixture of herbs. Out of those herbs, Kataka and Khadira are two herbs that are important in this medicinal formulation. These herbs are known for its anthelmintic, antidysenteric, antipyretic, antidiarrheal and many more properties. This formulation is present in decoction form. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Khadira (Acacia catechu) 
 Kataka (Strychnos potatorum) 
 Darvi (Berberis aristata) 
 Samanga (Cassia mimosoides) 
 Amla (Emblica officinalis) 
 Turmeric (Curcuma longa) 
 Vairi (Salacia reticulata) 
 Chootabija (Mangifera indica) 
 Pata (Cyclea peltata) 
 Abda (Cyperus rotundus) 
 Vidula (Barringtonia acutangula) 
 haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients up to 10 grams and pour in to a container. 
 Now add the 8 times water to that container and boil the water. 
 Boil the water mixture till it reduced up to one-fourth level and filter after boiling process. 
 Now decoction is prepared. 
 
 Dosage 
 5 to 10 ml on an empty stomach, once or twice a day, with equal amounts of water, before meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Diabetes 
 Neuropathy 
 Urinary ailments 
 Skin problems 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage might cause Hypoglycemia. 
 Medicine should be taken under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
